latest.basis: Latest complete FY actual source for approved CFO/CapEx/DA carry-forward ratios, not a forecast.

forecastActuals.workingCapitalBasis: Arithmetic mean of five consecutive annual change-in-NWC/revenue ratios. Change in NWC = negative FMP cash-flow changeInWorkingCapital (includes other operating working capital); positive increases consume cash. Not a difference of only receivables, inventories and payables.

revenueProvenance.comparabilityBasis: The 2007-2016 IAS18/IAS17 group is supported by merger continuity, not an assumption about pre-IPO figures: sjm-2008-annual/pages64,66 explicitly treats the reorganised group as a continuing entity and presents 2007/2008 as if the current structure existed throughout. FY2017/H12017 are the issuer's IFRS15-restated comparatives and share the 2018 IFRS15/IAS17 basis. From 2019 the IFRS15/IFRS16 group retains before-gaming-tax revenue, the same complete-line derived operating-profit definition and explicitly expensed D&A including ROU depreciation. sjm-2023-annual/pages100,104,149 presents 2023 and 2022 on that same consolidated income/expense basis across concession renewal; changed concession asset/fee amounts remain actual expenses, not an unreviewed pro forma restatement. FY2025 in sjm-2025-annual/pages120,124,167 and H12025/H12026 in sjm-2026-interim/pages15,26 support current TTM. Grouping never fills missing interest/EPS or makes published EPS additive.
revenueProvenance.basis: Consolidated gaming plus non-gaming service revenues before separately expensed special gaming tax, levy and premium. Early 2007/2008 totals are the sum of the two explicitly disclosed gaming/non-gaming revenue lines, not a gross-up of provider revenue. FY2017/H12017 use published IFRS15 restatements of commissions and service revenue. Earlier years are not retrospectively bridged without issuer evidence.
revenueProvenance.operatingIncomeBasis: Derived from the complete disclosed operating lines: gaming revenue less gaming tax/levy/premium, plus non-gaming service income less its disclosed cost, plus other income/gains/losses, less impairment, marketing/promotion and operating/administrative expenses. Excludes separately presented finance costs and equity-accounted associate/joint-venture results. This presentation-based derived subtotal includes interest income and other gains contained in issuer other income; it is not a reported GAAP subtotal or adjusted-property EBITDA. Reconciles to pretax profit plus finance costs less associate/JV results.
revenueProvenance.limitations: No consolidated GP/COGS subtotal is reported: non-gaming cost of services is not total group COGS. Operating income is explicitly derived, not mislabeled reported; the derivation includes issuer other-income items including bank interest and gains. D&A sums explicitly disclosed expensed PPE/ROU depreciation, intangible/concession amortisation and, before IFRS16, expensed prepaid-land-use-right amortisation (described as land-use operating lease rentals in the cash-flow/charging notes). Capitalised prepaid-land releases are excluded. From 2019 land/lease depreciation is already in ROU depreciation and is not added twice. FY2024/2025 and H12025 deduct disclosed capitalised PPE depreciation rather than using gross cash-flow addbacks. No D&A is inferred from adjusted EBITDA. interestExpense denotes expensed finance costs, including imputed interest. H12009 standalone interest income is not separately disclosed in the reviewed interim notes; H12010 interest24.6 is explicitly supported by the 2011 interim comparative. FY2007 interest67.5 sums the explicitly disclosed components62.5+4.9+0.1. FY2007/H12007 are actual issuer-published pre-IPO group comparatives, not invented public-company periods. SJM's official archive supplies the 2008 annual/interim and 2009 interim PDFs outside the captured 2010-onward HKEX index; their real issuer URLs and SHA256s are cited. No diluted EPS is invented where the report says N/A or supplies basic only. No unreviewed balance-sheet/cash-flow certification.
